gloss: time and effort; time and labor

definitions.gloss: time and effort; time and labor
definitions.explanation: The combination of effort (手間) and time (暇) invested in doing something carefully. Emphasizes that something requires both patience and work.

examples.japanese: {手間暇|てまひま}をかけて{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To make something with time and effort.

examples.japanese: {手間暇|てまひま}かけた{料理|りょうり}は{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Food made with time and care is delicious.

examples.japanese: この{味噌|みそ}は{職人|しょくにん}が{手間暇|てまひま}を{惜|お}しまず{仕込|しこ}んだものだ。
examples.english: This miso was prepared by a craftsman who spared no time or effort.

notes:
A compound of {手間|てま} (effort, labor) and {暇|ひま} (time, free time). Together they emphasize the dual investment of both effort and time. Often used positively to praise careful, dedicated work, especially in food preparation and craftsmanship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手間暇|てまひま}をかける: to put in time and effort
- {手間暇|てまひま}を{惜|お}しまない: to spare no time or effort
- {手間暇|てまひま}かけた{料理|りょうり}: food made with care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手間|てま}: effort / labor — focuses on the work involved, without the time component
- {苦労|くろう}: hardship / trouble — implies difficulty and suffering, not just investment of effort
- {手数|てすう}: trouble / bother — often used in polite expressions like お{手数|てすう}ですが

USAGE:
Very common in food and craft contexts. Advertising and product descriptions often use {手間暇|てまひま}をかけた to emphasize that something was made with care. Can also be written as {手間|てま}ヒマ or {手間|てま}ひま.
